name: outcome-qa
description: A senior QA playbook for coding agents: prioritize risks, test real user journeys, and verify what actually happened.

interface.longDescription: Test web apps, APIs, integrations and AI features with seven focused QA methods. Start from requirements, adapt to new evidence, verify fixes and hand off reproducible findings.
interface.defaultPrompt: Test this feature against its requirements: exercise the user journey, investigate meaningful risks and verify the resulting state.
